title: Public-gift restrictions and private consideration
summary: The editors compare public-gift limitations with ordinary bargain analysis.
notes:
Casebook discussion of a shorter authority.

King County’s taxpayers case and Turken v. Gordon show why the adequacy or public-purpose questions under a particular constitutional restriction can differ from private contract consideration. The account preserves the doctrinal comparison and does not draw a present policy verdict.

sources.label: Farnsworth et al., Contracts: Cases and Materials, 10th ed. (2023), pp. 61–62. Open assigned page 61.
